issues.description: The problem statement specifies that calculateTotalPrice should compute the net cost with double precision and the UML shows calculateTotalPrice(Meal): double, but the provided solution implementation declares calculateTotalPrice as returning int. This mismatch between the expected double return type and the actual int return type can confuse students about the required method signature and precision and may cause tests or further implementations to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the signature of calculateTotalPrice to return double and update its implementation to compute and return a double (e.g., use a double accumulator). Ensure all references to this method (and any tests/examples) expect a double. For example, in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java declare public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and sum ingredient prices into a double before returning.
